name: Umbel
description: An umbel: every stalk springing from one point and reaching the same height.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(46% 100%, 54% 100%, 96% 14%, 88% 10%, 50% 78%, 12% 10%, 4% 14%); clip-path: polygon(46% 100%, 54% 100%, 96% 14%, 88% 10%, 50% 78%, 12% 10%, 4% 14%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 34%; top: 2%; width: 32%; height: 22%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 180deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 180deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
